```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggrepel)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

## Importing GFS DATA
setwd("C:/Users/amoeaki/Downloads")
gfs_raw <- read.csv("GFS_data.csv")

#CSV file messed up headings
#renaming headings to be proper
names(gfs_raw) <- names(gfs_raw) %>%
  str_trim()

#Remove X in headings, replace "." with " ".
names(gfs_raw) <- names(gfs_raw) |>
  stringr::str_remove("^X")
names(gfs_raw) <- gsub("\\.", " ", names(gfs_raw))

# Renaming headings to use underscore 
names(gfs_raw)[names(gfs_raw) == "GFS Code"] <- "GFS_Code"
names(gfs_raw)[names(gfs_raw) == "Parent Code"] <- "Parent_Code"
# ADD FY infront of years FY20xx
names(gfs_raw)[names(gfs_raw) %in% as.character(2018:2026)] <-
  paste0("FY", 2018:2026)
gfs_raw <- gfs_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("FY"), as.numeric)
  )


##Convert to long format
gfs_long <- gfs_raw %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^FY?20(18|19|20|21|22|23|24|25|26)$"),
    names_to = "FiscalYear",
    values_to = "Amount"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # Remove FY if present
    FiscalYear = as.numeric(
      str_remove(FiscalYear, "^FY")
    ),
    
    # Ensure amount is numeric
    Amount = as.numeric(Amount)
    
  )

gfs_long <- gfs_long %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    GFS_Code = as.character(GFS_Code),
    
    Parent_Code = as.character(Parent_Code),
    
    Category = as.character(Category),
    
    Level = as.numeric(Level)
    
  )


major_categories <- gfs_long %>%
  
  filter(Level == 1) %>%
  
  distinct(
    GFS_Code,
    Category
  ) %>%
  
  arrange(GFS_Code)



# Adding Dashboard Hiearchy to include Debt Financing, Grants, fiscal Balance

dashboard_categories <- tribble(

  ~Dashboard_Code, ~Dashboard_Category,

  "REV",  "Revenue",
  "EXP",  "Expense",
  "GR",   "Grants",
  "DEBT", "Debt Financing",
  "FB",   "Fiscal Balance"

)


# ============================================================
# DASHBOARD COMPONENT MAPPING
#
# Maps dashboard categories to the existing GFS codes.
# ============================================================

dashboard_mapping <- tribble(

  ~Dashboard_Code, ~GFS_Code, ~Component,

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # REVENUE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  "REV", "11", "Taxes",
  "REV", "13", "Grants",
  "REV", "14", "Other revenue",


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # EXPENSE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  "EXP", "21", "Compensation of employees",
  "EXP", "22", "Use of goods and services",
  "EXP", "24", "Interest",
  "EXP", "25", "Subsidies",
  "EXP", "26", "Grants",
  "EXP", "27", "Social benefits",
  "EXP", "28", "Other expense",


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # GRANTS
  #
  # Revenue grants = GFS 13
  # Expenditure grants = GFS 26
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  "GR", "13", "Grants received",
  "GR", "26", "Grants paid",


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DEBT FINANCING
  #
  # Existing GFS financial liability codes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  "DEBT", "3314", "Domestic loans",
  "DEBT", "3315", "Domestic repayments",
  "DEBT", "3324", "Foreign loans",
  "DEBT", "3328", "Foreign repayments"

)


# ============================================================
# CREATE DASHBOARD LONG DATASET
#
# This takes the existing GFS observations and attaches
# the dashboard category to them.
# ============================================================

dashboard_long <- dashboard_mapping %>%

  left_join(
    gfs_long,
    by = "GFS_Code"
  ) %>%

  select(
    Dashboard_Code,
    GFS_Code,
    Component,
    Category,
    Parent_Code,
    Level,
    FiscalYear,
    Amount
  )


# ============================================================
# FISCAL BALANCE
#
# Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement is already contained
# in the GFS data, but does not have a GFS code.
#
# We therefore create a dashboard observation for it.
# ============================================================

fiscal_balance <- gfs_long %>%

  filter(
    Category == "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement"
  ) %>%

  select(
    FiscalYear,
    Amount
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Dashboard_Code = "FB",

    GFS_Code = "NLBR",

    Component = "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement",

    Category = "Fiscal Balance",

    Parent_Code = NA_character_,

    Level = 1

  )


# ============================================================
# ADD FISCAL BALANCE TO DASHBOARD DATA
# ============================================================

dashboard_long <- bind_rows(

  dashboard_long,

  fiscal_balance %>%

    select(
      Dashboard_Code,
      GFS_Code,
      Component,
      Category,
      Parent_Code,
      Level,
      FiscalYear,
      Amount
    )

)



# ============================================================
# 6. CREATE LABELS FOR DROPDOWN
# ============================================================

category_choices <- setNames(
  major_categories$GFS_Code,
  major_categories$Category
)


# ============================================================
# 7. YEARS AVAILABLE
# ============================================================

available_years <- sort(
  unique(gfs_long$FiscalYear)
)




```

```{r}
)
```

### Total

```{r}

renderValueBox({

  selected_code <- input$selected_category

  selected_year <- as.numeric(
    input$selected_year
  )

  value <- dashboard_long %>%

    filter(
      Dashboard_Code == selected_code,
      FiscalYear == selected_year
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      Total = sum(
        Amount,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%

    pull(Total)


  category_name <- dashboard_categories %>%

    filter(
      Dashboard_Code == selected_code
    ) %>%

    pull(Dashboard_Category)


  valueBox(
    value = paste0(
      "$",
      comma(
        value,
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),
      "m"
    ),

    caption = paste(
      category_name,
      "— FY",
      selected_year
    ),

    color = "#1F3A5F"
  )

})

#primary color before
```

### Bar Chart

```{r middle_charts}
 renderPlotly({

  selected_year <- as.numeric(input$selected_year)
  selected_code <- as.character(input$selected_category)


  # ============================================================
  # REVENUE
  # ============================================================

  if (selected_code == "REV") {

    component_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(
        Parent_Code == "1",
        FiscalYear == selected_year,
        !is.na(Amount)
      ) %>%

      arrange(Amount)

    category_name <- "Revenue"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # EXPENSE
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "EXP") {

    component_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(
        Parent_Code == "2",
        FiscalYear == selected_year,
        !is.na(Amount)
      ) %>%

      arrange(Amount)

    category_name <- "Expense"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # GRANTS
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "GR") {

    component_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(
        GFS_Code %in% c("13", "26"),
        FiscalYear == selected_year,
        !is.na(Amount)
      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Category = case_when(

          GFS_Code == "13" ~ "Grants received",

          GFS_Code == "26" ~ "Grants paid"

        )

      ) %>%

      arrange(Amount)

    category_name <- "Grants"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # DEBT FINANCING
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "DEBT") {

    component_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        GFS_Code %in% c(
          "3314",
          "3315",
          "3324",
          "3328"
        ),

        FiscalYear == selected_year,

        !is.na(Amount)

      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Category = case_when(

          GFS_Code == "3314" ~ "Domestic loans",

          GFS_Code == "3315" ~ "Domestic repayments",

          GFS_Code == "3324" ~ "Foreign loans",

          GFS_Code == "3328" ~ "Foreign repayments"

        )

      ) %>%

      arrange(Amount)

    category_name <- "Debt Financing"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # FISCAL BALANCE
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "FB") {

    component_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        Category ==
          "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement",

        FiscalYear ==
          selected_year,

        !is.na(Amount)

      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Category =
          "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement"

      )

    category_name <- "Fiscal Balance"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # NO DATA
  # ============================================================

  if (nrow(component_data) == 0) {

    return(

      plot_ly() %>%

        layout(
          title = "No component data available"
        )

    )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # PLOT
  # ============================================================

  plot_ly(

    component_data,

    x = ~Amount,

    y = ~reorder(
      Category,
      Amount
    ),

    type = "bar",

    orientation = "h",

    text = ~paste0(

      Category,

      "<br>$",

      comma(
        Amount,
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),

      "m"

    ),

    hoverinfo = "text"

  ) %>%

    layout(

      title = paste(

        category_name,

        "— FY",

        selected_year

      ),

      xaxis = list(
        title = "$ million"
      ),

      yaxis = list(
        title = ""
      )

    )

})

```

### Composition of Category

```{r pie}
 
 renderPlotly({

  selected_year <- as.numeric(
    input$selected_year
  )

  selected_code <- as.character(
    input$selected_category
  )


  # ============================================================
  # REVENUE
  # ============================================================

  if (selected_code == "REV") {

    pie_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        Parent_Code == "1",

        FiscalYear == selected_year

      )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # EXPENSE
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "EXP") {

    pie_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        Parent_Code == "2",

        FiscalYear == selected_year

      )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # GRANTS
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "GR") {

    pie_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        GFS_Code %in% c("13", "26"),

        FiscalYear == selected_year

      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Category = case_when(

          GFS_Code == "13" ~ "Grants received",

          GFS_Code == "26" ~ "Grants paid out"

        )

      )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # DEBT
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "DEBT") {

    pie_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        GFS_Code %in% c(
          "3314",
          "3315",
          "3324",
          "3328"
        ),

        FiscalYear == selected_year

      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Category = case_when(

          GFS_Code == "3314" ~ "Domestic loans",

          GFS_Code == "3315" ~ "Domestic repayments",

          GFS_Code == "3324" ~ "Foreign loans",

          GFS_Code == "3328" ~ "Foreign repayments"

        )

      )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # FISCAL BALANCE
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "FB") {

    pie_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        Category ==
          "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement",

        FiscalYear ==
          selected_year

      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Category =
          "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement"

      )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # CLEAN DATA
  # ============================================================

  pie_data <- pie_data %>%

    filter(

      !is.na(Amount),

      Amount != 0

    )


  # ============================================================
  # NO DATA
  # ============================================================

  if (nrow(pie_data) == 0) {

    return(

      plot_ly() %>%

        layout(
          title = "No data available"
        )

    )

  }


  # ============================================================
  # CALCULATE PERCENTAGE
  # ============================================================

  pie_data <- pie_data %>%

    mutate(

      Percentage =
        Amount /
        sum(Amount) *
        100

    )


  # ============================================================
  # PIE CHART
  # ============================================================

  plot_ly(

    pie_data,

    labels = ~Category,

    values = ~Amount,

    type = "pie",

    textinfo = "label+percent",

    hovertemplate =
      paste0(

        "<b>%{label}</b>",

        "<br>$%{value:.1f}m",

        "<br>%{percent}",

        "<extra></extra>"

      )

  ) %>%

    layout(

      title = list(

        text = paste(

          "Composition — FY",

          selected_year

        )

      )

    )

})
```

### Historical Trend

```{r}

renderPlotly({

  selected_code <- as.character(
    input$selected_category
  )


  # ============================================================
  # REVENUE
  # ============================================================

  if (selected_code == "REV") {

    historical_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(
        GFS_Code == "1",
        !is.na(Amount)
      )

    category_name <- "Revenue"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # EXPENSE
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "EXP") {

    historical_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(
        GFS_Code == "2",
        !is.na(Amount)
      )

    category_name <- "Expense"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # GRANTS
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "GR") {

    historical_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(
        GFS_Code %in% c("13", "26"),
        !is.na(Amount)
      ) %>%

      group_by(FiscalYear) %>%

      summarise(
        Amount = sum(
          Amount,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    category_name <- "Grants"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # DEBT FINANCING
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "DEBT") {

    historical_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        GFS_Code %in% c(
          "3314",
          "3315",
          "3324",
          "3328"
        ),

        !is.na(Amount)

      ) %>%

      group_by(FiscalYear) %>%

      summarise(

        Amount = sum(
          Amount,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        .groups = "drop"

      )

    category_name <- "Debt Financing"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # FISCAL BALANCE
  # ============================================================

  else if (selected_code == "FB") {

    historical_data <- gfs_long %>%

      filter(

        Category ==
          "Net Lending/Borrowing Requirement",

        !is.na(Amount)

      )

    category_name <- "Fiscal Balance"

  }


  # ============================================================
  # PLOT
  # ============================================================

  plot_ly(

    historical_data,

    x = ~FiscalYear,

    y = ~Amount,

    type = "scatter",

    mode = "lines+markers",

    text = ~paste0(

      "FY",
      FiscalYear,

      "<br>",
      category_name,

      ": $",

      comma(
        Amount,
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),

      "m"

    ),

    hoverinfo = "text"

  ) %>%

    layout(

      title = paste(
        category_name,
        "Over Time"
      ),

      xaxis = list(

        title = "",

        tickmode = "array",

        tickvals = 2018:2026,

        ticktext = paste0(
          "FY",
          2018:2026
        )

      ),

      yaxis = list(
        title = "$ million"
      )

    )

})

```
